title: Minimize CI init cost and add dependency lease orchestrator
author: Maya Patel
description:
Summary: This PR reduces presubmit/init latency by deferring noncritical install steps, introduces a lightweight dependency-lease orchestrator for on-demand toolcache population, and tidyies several CI boot scripts.

Motivation: CI setup time is a major contributor to developer feedback latency for small changes. We observed repeated installs of large devdeps in the init path even when tests didn't need them (typical fastpath change). This increases queue times and burn rate on ephemeral runners.

Goals:
1) Make the common fastpath (lint + unit) initialize in <60s on cold images.
2) Allow non-blocking background population of large caches (python wheels, node modules) with a lease so multiple runners coordinate and avoid thundering-herd installs.
3) Keep behavior opt-in and reversible for compatibility with release presubmits and enterprise customers.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced ci/lease manager (pkg/ci/lease/*) that grants short-lived "dependency leases" stored in the toolcache blobstore; runners request leases before running heavy installs.
- Split .github workflows: presubmit-fast.yml (fastpath, limited deps) and presubmit-deferred.yml (background population after merge-ready).
- Added scripts/ci/bootstrap-fast.sh to do a minimal bootstrap (venv, required wheels only) and timeboxed install logic.
- Added go-based toolcache primer (ci/toolcache/primer.go) that runs in the background and respects lease ownership.
- Optional feature flag CI_DEP_LEASE=1 toggles behavior; default enabled for main.

Checklist:
- [x] Minimal fast bootstrap script implemented
- [x] Lease manager + primitive tests
- [x] Workflows split and documented
- [x] Fallback to previous behavior if lease service unavailable
- [x] Migration notes for Dedicated/Private CI in RELEASE_NOTES

Commits (summary):
- 9a3d2b1  Add lease manager scaffold and basic API
- 4f7c8a2  Implement timeboxed bootstrap script and runner flags
- e3b7f11  Introduce presubmit-fast and presubmit-deferred workflows
- d2c1a55  Add primer tool and integration smoke test
- 7b5e9c3  Docs: CI_DEP_LEASE usage and migration notes

Files changed (high level):
- .github/workflows/presubmit-fast.yml (new)
- .github/workflows/presubmit-deferred.yml (new)
- scripts/ci/bootstrap-fast.sh (new)
- ci/toolcache/primer.go (new)
- pkg/ci/lease/manager.go (new)
- pkg/ci/lease/manager_test.go (new tests)
- Dockerfile.ci (small tweak to include toolcache binary)
- tools/ci/README.md (docs and migration steps)
- scripts/ci/legacy-init.sh (refactor to call bootstrap-fast when appropriate)
- release/RELEASE_NOTES.md (migration notes)

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for lease manager (pkg/ci/lease) added; simple lock semantics validated.
- Integration smoke runs that simulate two concurrent runners requesting a lease; validated no duplicated heavy installs.
- CI matrix: linux, macos, windows (fastpath only runs on PRs); deferred workflow triggered on push to release branches and on a nightly window.
- Observed end-to-end speedup: median init time reduced ~48% on sample branch with typical fastpath changes.

Review conversation (high level):
- Jordan Kim: "Can we ensure the lease TTL is adaptive to runner startup variance? If TTL is too short we risk repeated installs."
  Author: "Added adaptive TTL logic: base TTL + jitter based on runner timestamp. See manager.go lines ~120-160."
- Liam O'Connor: "What if primer fails (network flake) — do we block merges?"
  Author: "No — primer/deferred population is best-effort. The fastpath workflow explicitly avoids waiting on primer. We added a retry/backoff and a health endpoint; broken primer will be logged but won't block presubmits."
- Sofia Ruiz: "Add note for Dedicated customers who run custom images."
  Author: "Added migration section and env var toggle; ops can opt-out by setting CI_DEP_LEASE=0."

CI checks and run history:
- lint: pass
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-smoke: pass (rerun once due to transient network error)
- e2e: skipped for fastpath
- security-scan: pass

Merge: Squash-merged to main on 2024-11-12 after approvals from Jordan and Liam.

Rollout plan and notes:
- Feature enabled by default on main for faster feedback; release branch builds keep legacy path for first 2 weeks.
- Monitor toolcache hit-rate and runner-init times in console dashboard (added widgets: CI.InitTime/percentile and CI.Toolcache.HitRate).
- If adoption causes unexpected failures, set CI_DEP_LEASE=0 at org level and revertable patch is prepared (branch/ci-dep-lease-orchestrator-revert).

Release notes: "Reduce PR feedback latency by introducing a fast bootstrap path and an optional dependency lease orchestrator to avoid redundant heavy installs on CI runners. Default enabled; org opt-out available."
